capabilities.text: Choose the reaction: one of six real reversible reactions or a made-up A + B ⇌ C
capabilities.note: Ours has no reaction list; the teacher types any reaction’s species and coefficients (up to two reactants and two products).

capabilities.text: Make the forward reaction exothermic or endothermic
capabilities.note: Ours uses ΔH only for a temperature stress. Token passes on the stress alone; checked by hand that the sign of ΔH changes the render.

capabilities.text: Set each species’ starting concentration (from reactants, products or a mixture)
Set K
Set the time equilibrium is first established
capabilities.note: Ours draws the approach in arbitrary time units with no control for when it settles.

capabilities.text: Add stresses, each at the time you type
capabilities.evidence: changes:{"dist":"Add a species","dist_time":6} + changes:{"dist":"Add a species","dist2":"Change the volume"}

capabilities.text: Add a third stress
Stress by adding or removing a species
capabilities.evidence: changes:dist=Add a species + changes:dist=Remove a species

capabilities.text: Stress by changing the volume
Stress by raising or lowering the temperature
capabilities.evidence: changes:dist=Change the temperature + changes:{"dist":"Change the temperature","dist_t2":250}

capabilities.text: Write the page’s own words for each stress (“N₂ added”, “Volume halved”) over its dashed line
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: ours writes “t = 8: Add 0.5 M H₂” and the Q-vs-K shift above the dashed line.

capabilities.text: Write your own words for a stress
Leave a stress’s words off
Write each line’s formula beside it
capabilities.note: Formulas with their final values are written at each line’s end at the opening state; the token shows they follow the data.

capabilities.text: Hide the lines’ formulas
Draw the lines in color or in black, told apart as solid, dashed and dotted
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: Print draws solid, dashed and dotted lines with markers.

capabilities.text: Write a chart title
Write the axis titles
Put a blank line in place of the chart or an axis title
Set the axis ranges, with a Fit button
capabilities.note: Ours always fits the axes; no ranges.

capabilities.text: Set the axis numbering (every line, 2nd, 5th, 10th, or none)
Add minor gridlines, 2, 4 or 5 per block
capabilities.note: Ours has major gridlines on or off only.

capabilities.text: Set the label size
